news.title: Key Facts About U.S. Data Centers
news.summary_en: Data centers are expanding fast to power AI, and public backlash is growing. Here are some key facts on their locations, energy use and Americans’ views.

news.title: What We Know – and Don’t Know – About Flock’s License Plate Cameras
